features.name: 独立原生基线
features.description: 增加 stock NoneBot/Koishi 原生路径，复用同发布物与独立 oracle。
features.done_when: 四个支持版本双路径回归及 wrong-recipient/同错反例通过；native 不导入 Ligamina Bridge。
features.evidence: S2-05 前置 pwsh -NoProfile -File init.ps1 -Mode full baseline exited 0. Final pinned Linux Docker Worker run passed all four previously supported exact versions: NoneBot autohelp 0.1.7, repeater 3.1.4, Koishi game-mini 0.4.3, and multi-qa 1.0.8. Each Native and Federated path completed against the same artifact/lock/config/stimulus fingerprints, passed the independent expected oracle and pair comparison, and confirmed cleanup. The native sources do not import Ligamina Bridge. Lab tests 52/52 include one-side and both-sides wrong-recipient negatives; pwsh -NoProfile -File init.ps1 -Mode full exited 0. Windows Sandbox was blocked before plugin start (App Control, Win32 4551); no Windows plugin behavior is claimed. Full census and real-platform delivery remain untested.

Missing fixture/config/service/random/time/credentials are explicit skipped states; secret-bearing fixtures fail closed. Native and Federated are checked separately against the independent oracle before pair comparison, including the same-wrong-output negative. Full validation exited 0: lab 60, NoneBot 3, Koishi 7, MCP 1, reference 5, Rust 29; Windows Core smoke 4 events / 4 gateway ops / 0 PIDs and bundle stage passed. Category dry run suggests 69/5,690 entries; 5,621 remain explicit unmapped_category. Recipes remain declarative; no catalog plugin was executed.
